name: The Funky Bazaar
demographics: The Funky Bazaar attracts a diverse mix of bohemian-minded visitors, artists, and tourists exploring the mountain community of Idyllwild-Pine Cove. The primary demographic skews toward middle to upper-middle income households aged 35-65 who appreciate unique, handcrafted goods and alternative lifestyle products. The trade area draws from both local residents of this small artistic mountain town and weekend visitors from Southern California's urban centers seeking eclectic shopping experiences. Shoppers here value authenticity, local artisanship, and one-of-a-kind finds over mass-market retail, with a strong preference for supporting independent merchants and local craftspeople.
description: The Funky Bazaar is a one-of-a-kind shopping destination nestled in the artistic mountain community of Idyllwild-Pine Cove, California, offering what they describe as "an indefinable assortment of local arts, crafts, collectibles, curiosities and just plain cool sh#!@." This steam-punk friendly and proudly weird marketplace serves as a curated collective showcasing the work of multiple local merchants and artisans, each bringing their unique creative vision to the bazaar. Open Thursday through Sunday, the storefront features an eclectic mix of categories including handcrafted jewelry, funky eyewear, home décor, art, apparel, accessories, and gifts for the eccentric soul. The Funky Bazaar has become a beloved destination for those seeking alternatives to mainstream retail, with its directory of shops functioning as a "backstage pass" to a cast of weird and wonderful talent. With a strong 4.7-star rating from 44 reviews, this quirky marketplace has established itself as a must-visit destination for anyone exploring the charming mountain town of Idyllwild, offering both an online shopping experience and an immersive in-person browsing adventure that celebrates local creativity and unconventional style.
summary: The Funky Bazaar is a delightfully eccentric marketplace in Idyllwild-Pine Cove featuring local arts, crafts, collectibles, and curiosities from multiple independent merchants. This steam-punk friendly destination offers everything from funky eyewear to handcrafted jewelry, celebrating weird and wonderful creativity in a mountain town setting.
